stories.title: Iran protests enter third week under internet blackout
stories.summary: As Iran's protests enter a third week, the country's president blames foreign powers for the unrest, and warns it will retaliate if the US intervenes militarily.

stories.title: Europe alarmed by Trump's Greenland push
stories.summary: Europe is increasingly alarmed by Trump's talk of annexing Greenland, an autonomous Danish territory in the EU and NATO, especially after the U.S. incursion in Venezuela last weekend.

stories.title: Trump promised a Gaza endgame. Palestinians say they are still living the war
stories.summary: Three months after Trump's Gaza plan, Palestinians say the war is still not over and no international force has arrived.

stories.title: Supreme Court weighs bans on trans athletes in women's and girls' sports teams
stories.summary: The Supreme Court hears two cases this week on state bans for trans athletes playing on women's and girls' sports teams. Kate Sosin, who covers LGBTQ issues for the non-profit newsroom The 19th, has been following these cases closely.

stories.title: Founding Grateful Dead member dies at 78
stories.summary: Bob Weir, who helped build the Grateful Dead from the Haight-Ashbury scene into a cultural institution, has died at 78.

stories.title: 'ScreenTime' podcast asks what screens are doing to kids
stories.summary: Andrew Bracken, a journalist at KPBS, on how how his experiences as a parent with technology led to a new podcast.
